items.title: Tape is so not dead that Fujifilm will increase production capacity 5x

items.lede: Fujifilm plans to increase the production of magnetic tape by as much as 5x as it works to meet a newfound demand for AI data center storage.
items.title: Fujifilm plans 5x production boost of 100TB magnetic storage tapes driven by skyrocketing AI storage demand — $63 million injection is the largest investment in tape for 20 years

items.lede: Low costs and offline security mean magnetic tape still has a job.
items.title: Fujifilm to boost tape production 5x as AI fuels archiving demand
